fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on estimated 2002 consumption of ~90 million gallons (per item7a: a one-cent change in fuel price = ~$0.9M impact based on ~90M gal); commodity call options establish ceiling prices for portions of 2002 fuel requirements.

instrument_type_details.notes: Commodity call options establishing ceiling prices (caps) on jet fuel. Coverage at Dec 31, 2001: Q1 2002 = 50% of needs, Q2 2002 = 25%, Q3 2002 = 10%, Q4 2002 = 0%. Company estimated 2002 fuel consumption ~90M gal. Fair value of options not separately disclosed in item7a or item8_notes. Options recorded at cost; unrealized changes tracked through OCI as cash flow hedges under SFAS 133.

throughput.source_quote: Aircraft fuel and oil and associated taxes decreased $6.8 million, or 7.2%, in 2001. Into-plane fuel prices decreased 9.0% per gallon, averaging 91.5¢ per gallon in 2001 versus $1.01 per gallon in 2000. Fuel consumption increased 2.0% in 2001. [Derived: 2002 fuel $78.7M decreased $8.3M (9.5%) from 2001; 2001 = $87.0M / $0.915 = 95.1M gallons; 2002 = 94.6M × 0.993 confirms 2001 ≈ 95.3M]

warnings: Fair value of call options not separately disclosed; net_fair_value_mm set to null.
Coverage front-loaded: 50% Q1, 25% Q2, 10% Q3, 0% Q4 2002.
